summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential supply data, find what the launch plan misses, and build a general product (poller, extraction/recheck agents, supplier emailing, Today/Routines UI) with docs, interview prep and a hand-in by Sunday 12:00.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch despite an 'all ok' plan (overbooked art book receipt, failed statues, stale data) and built a working app that ingests drops, raises cases, emails suppliers, and handles routines. Many UX and ingestion fixes were committed on jonas/today-flow, but push, README, demo script, video and some channel gaps remain.

repo: Portal API has only files list, single file and archive.zip; no webhooks or notifications. Files can be replaced under the same name, so change detection must compare SHA-256 checksums, and formats may change between drops.
Confidential portal data lives in the gitignored data/ folder; .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with it empty.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; tasks are claimed with a Now line in PROGRESS.md.

Drop drill on real pipeline found gaps: a renamed CSV column silently auto-resolved 3 real cards, the predictor wrote impacts.json in a different shape than papercheck (crashed the pipeline), any address in a supplier profile was trusted as a send target, and the first tracker file in sort order won over the newest.
A reply to a side email logged on a case wrongly marked the case as sent and removed it from 'Needs you'; replies now add info but do not decide.
Routine option matching searched a literal 'make po,rev' string instead of 'make po' and 'rev', so the routine found the case but sent nothing.
Prepared routine steps went stale when their case was decided manually, causing 'not an open card' errors; they must expire when the case closes and be deduped across routines.
Internal messages and escalations (DC site lead, Quality, Maren) are only recorded, with no channel; ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is empty so Hamburg questions go only as push notifications.
Rehearse drops safely on a copy of data/portal, state and store with ASK_REPLY_POLL=off, ASK_TEAMS=off and ASK_LLM_PROVIDER=none, on a second port.
workflow: Subagents were useful for long cross-checks (200 order confirmations plus 59 scans) and for drop drills and UX redesign, but one agent's uncommitted edits were picked up by another's commit (b0cff82), leaving a HEAD that imports an untracked module and would not start. Commit new modules together with files that import them.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change, so sessions with no file modifications show no checkpoints even though hooks fired.
Verify UI fixes in a real browser (J key navigation, scroll position measurements) rather than trusting type checks; this caught the list jump on selecting a decided case.
Judges score pitch, business case, technical depth, taste and a live demo on real data; they reward agents that act and general design, so stop new features and prioritise hand-in material.

friction: Portal token was initially empty, blocking data access until the user supplied it.
Suppliers only answer registered sender addresses, and it was unclear whether portal data is identical across teams or reacts to sent emails.
A test email to a non-existent Pulse address bounced, and extra manual tracking emails to PackRight were redundant after Lin Hui had already answered.
Screen claimed 'DC site lead has it now' for escalations that were only recorded, which is misleading.

Repeated UI issues in the Today list: left list did not scroll with selection, selecting a decided case jumped to the top, waiting steps missing from the sidebar, and four near-identical cards cluttered it.
Duplicate routines ('Ask Hamburg to count book stock') were created and would prepare every question twice.
Routines toggled on appeared not to run because status text said 'not run yet' and cases were marked seen on first run.
open_items: Push 23+ commits on jonas/today-flow (awaiting user approval).
Write README, demo script (around art books, clear cases and 'system says fine' stories), video and pitch slides before the 12:00 hand-in.
Send internal messages and escalations through push and Teams and make the UI state honestly where they went; user must create the Teams webhook for ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK.
Delete the duplicate 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' routine.
Decide whether to combine the four 'Are there really…' count questions into one case to reduce the 17 cases in 'Needs you'.
Improve the Today header to show the next decision-by time, not only the 20:00 countdown.
Send a note to Hwaseong and a message to Lucas about the Pulse test emails; send PackRight the rev C file and change notice and ask how much is unprinted.

Memo rules for Quality last word and air/rush escalation to CPO are extracted but not used for routing; a real predictor run is untested; renamed stock columns are only signaled by the datacheck warning.
Approving a new-contact card does not verify the confirmation phone call happened.
Funnel counts in the routine diagram are computed in the browser and may drift from routines.py; they are approximate for waiting and replies triggers.
Interview with Felix (Sat 15:15) doc exists; the earlier Claude doc and briefing page may be duplicates to delete; the Codex hooks still need approval in /hooks.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and ask the Lio engineers whether portal data is identical across teams; consider changing the portal password shared in Discord after the hack.
